findings.explanation: The endpoint does not verify ownership of the orders being accessed, allowing unauthorized users to access other users' orders.

evidence.content: - A user may view ONLY their own orders. Every endpoint that fetches an order by its identifier MUST verify ownership with `is_owner_or_admin(current_user, order.user_id)` before returning data.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a check to ensure the current user is the owner of the orders being accessed or has admin privileges.
